visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man is lying flat on a wooden floor, appearing deceased. A white tape outline of a body is marked on the floor around him. He wears a plain white T-shirt and holds a pink Quaker cereal bag on his chest. The lighting is dim and dramatic. (2) Scene shifts to a dimly lit room resembling an interrogation room. A man in a police uniform sits across from another man wearing an orange jumpsuit and a long blonde pigtail wig, portraying a suspect. Several Quaker cereal bags and a desk lamp are on the table. (3) A close-up promotional segment features the officer holding the pink cereal bag directly to the camera in a bright studio-like environment. He uses hand gestures to emphasize points. (4) Back in the interrogation room, the suspect in drag is seen eating cereal with handcuffs on. The officer brings a bowl and a mug of milk. (5) A close-up shot shows the cereal being poured into the bowl. (6) The suspect becomes emotional, holding two different flavored Quaker bags, looking upwards and shouting in a dramatic fashion. (7) The suspect points behind the officer, tricks him, and runs out of the frame while the officer looks away.

(3) BGM shifts to an upbeat, commercial-style electronic track with a steady percussion beat. The first male voice delivers rapid-fire informational content with high arousal. (4) Distinct percussive crunching sounds (eating) punctuate the dialogue, accompanied by a hollow thud as a bowl is placed. (5) A liquid pouring sound occurs, layered over the upbeat music. (7) Final phase features rapid rhythmic footsteps and a loud car tire screech sound effect as the track abruptly ends.
